name: Shri Tejasvi Surya
education:
B.A., LLB. 
Educated at Bangalore Institute of Legal Studies
 Bangalore Institute of Legal Studies
permanent_address: No. 381, 1st Phase 1st A Main Road, Near Vivekananda Park, Girinagar, Bengaluru Karnataka, 560085
social_activities:
Founded the Arise India Movement during his childhood; Through the foundation, raised important issues concerning education and regularly took out rallies expressing the need to educate the children of construction 
labourers; also organised a Midnight Freedom Run on August 14-15 of 2016, an event that was also attended by political leaders of Karnataka; Organised music festivals and other cultural activities regularly through his foundation
interests: An ardent follower of Swami Vivekananda, Dr. B.R. Ambedkar and Veer Savarkar, is well read on history, religion, and spirituality and is a core believer in Hindutva, the inclusive philosophy that is the core of Bharat since its ancient times; A lawyer by training and profession, also have deep interest in history, philosophy, science and civilisational studies
hobbies:
Trained in Carnatic Music, attends Carnatic and Hindustani concerts during his leisure time, also an avid reader and spends most of his free time studying about India`s history, modern times and technological challenges facing the country and also interested in documentaries that are 
well-researched and go deep into the subjects that are being filmed
sports: Likes to play cricket and badminton, also an avid jogger, likes to explore the outdoors on his cycle and enjoys the occasional swim

literary_activities:
A regular contributor to online publications and
Newspapers like Swarajya, India Facts and Kannada Prabha; Written several articles on constitutional law, culture, tourism, urban mobility and other topics concerning the ease of living of citizens
other_information:
Since being elected to office, consistently taken up the Urban Mobility Crisis in Bengaluru and is working on getting speedy clearances for big-ticket public transport solutions for Bengaluru; In addition to this, realising Bengaluru South has the most number of students who secured single-digit marks in the Tenth standard public examinations in Karnataka, started the Bengaluru South Education and Social Transformation project 
which aims to transform the academic infrastructure of schools in Bengaluru South; Has been a vocal supporter for an exclusive legislation for his city
Bengaluru, also expressed concern over the existing one-year term for the Mayor and has suggested that the Mayor`s tenure should be at least 3-5 years; and represents a new generation of political leaders who will lead India into the 21st century also keen on elevating homeless people in Bangaluru through the PM Awas Yojana
